adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6` `save()` sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`. If `categoryId` is `null` (e.g., a newly added host where the user doesn’t pick a category), the server normalizes it to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`). However, on success the client unconditionally runs `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')));`, which becomes `findById(null)` and sets `host.category` to `undefined`. The template renders `{{category-badge host.category}}`, so the row can show no category until a reload/refetch.
